title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Ranking Money Market Tiers for an Upgrade
content:
If a Savings & Money Market Accounts product is to be moved to the highest-ranked money market tier its owner qualifies for, the separate qualification tests of the tiers are brought together into one target by the ranking below.

## Rule

**Searching from the top.** The money market tiers are taken in descending rank: Private Client Money Market, next Premier Money Market, last Money Market Account. The highest of them for which the account qualifies becomes the target.

**The search halts at the tier the account is on.** Should the search arrive at the account's present tier with no higher tier having qualified, the account stays where it is and nothing is converted. An account that is already on Private Client Money Market stays there. An account on one of the savings tiers that qualifies for none of the three money market tiers also keeps its tier.

**Status.** A target different from the present tier arises only for an account whose status is Active at the moment the target is picked. For an account in any other status, Dormant included, the outcome is its present tier, and nothing is converted.

**Left out of the ranking.** The ranking ignores the per-customer ceiling on accounts of a tier and every other entry requirement a tier conversion carries. Those requirements are applied afterwards to the chosen target alone, as conditions of the conversion itself. A customer who falls short on any of them for that target, for example by already holding as many accounts of that tier as it permits, gets no conversion, and the next tier down is not offered in its place.

## Outcome table (hypothetical accounts, all with status Active)

| Present tier | Private Client Money Market qualifies | Premier Money Market qualifies | Money Market Account qualifies | Target |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Statement Savings | no | yes | yes | Premier Money Market |
| Money Market Account | no | no | yes | Money Market Account, unchanged |
| Premier Money Market | no | yes | yes | Premier Money Market, unchanged |
| Money Market Account | yes | yes | yes | Private Client Money Market |
| Starter Savings | no | no | no | Starter Savings, unchanged |
| Private Client Money Market | yes | yes | yes | Private Client Money Market, unchanged |

For an account whose status is anything but Active, every row gives the present tier.

## Points of judgement

**The target is Premier Money Market, but the customer already holds the most Premier Money Market accounts permitted. Is Money Market Account put through instead?** No. The conversion simply does not take place.

**A Premier Money Market account qualifies for Money Market Account. Is it moved down?** No. The search halts on reaching the present tier, so an account is never moved to a lower rank.
